about.title: A note from Astraa
paragraphs: I’m Astraa, a fullstack developer in Vietnam. I build expressive interfaces, thoughtful motion, and the components, APIs, and data flows behind them.

My strongest focus is expressive UI, thoughtful motion, and the details that make an experience feel finished. Underneath the visual layer, I build the components, APIs, and data flows that make it work.
Currently building ProZ0, a browser-first pixel-art survival and exploration sandbox. Open to frontend and fullstack opportunities, especially where UI and interaction matter.

projects.name: MediMate AI
projects.description: An AI-assisted pre-visit interface for symptom intake, care discovery, and patient workflows. Making complex information feel clear, calm, and approachable.

projects.name: FinGenie
projects.description: AI-assisted personal finance across web and mobile. A shared codebase brings together a Next.js web app, a NestJS API, an Expo mobile app, and PostgreSQL.

projects.name: GeoConnect
projects.description: Location-based communities, interactive maps, and real-time messaging. Built with React, Leaflet, and Socket.io.

projects.name: CVmate
projects.description: CV creation, ATS-oriented feedback, and interview practice. An interface for preparing the next step, built with React, TypeScript, and Hugging Face.

projects.name: MLN Web
projects.description: An interactive Vietnamese Party history learning platform, with lessons, timelines, and quizzes.

projects.name: MLN AI
projects.description: A Vietnamese Marx–Lenin philosophy learning application with an AI chatbot and a dedicated sign-in experience. Built with React, FastAPI and Supabase.

projects.name: Nét Studio
projects.description: A bilingual creative studio website with cobalt engraved illustrations, switchable palettes, project filters, and a downloadable brief. Built with React, GSAP, and Lenis.

projects.name: Garden Dreams
projects.description: A Vietnamese florist storefront with product discovery, a cart, personalised cards, and customer order history. Built with React and Supabase.

projects.name: Ecommerce Mobile
projects.description: A React Native and Expo shopping experience with product browsing, a wishlist, a cart, and order history.

projects.name: ProZ0
projects.description: A 2D pixel-art survival and exploration sandbox about building a new civilization and uncovering the traces of an older one. Its Phase 1 vertical slice is in development.

projects.name: MediMate Mobile
projects.description: The mobile companion to MediMate AI, built with React Native and Expo. A personal health interface for sign-in, health profiles and care workflows.
